supportedTeachingClaims: Current prototype supports exploring and selecting displayed structures. Anatomical completeness, female-specific attachment accuracy, muscle activation and movement mechanics are not validated. Intended yoga/Pilates movement teaching remains unreleased.

coverage.requirements: Review the 20 audited targets: identity, side, segmentation, selection, provenance and any teaching-scope exclusions. A source name alone is insufficient.

landmarks.requirements: Document the reference build, anatomical point definitions and measured distances; distinguish bounding-box proxies and artistic proportions. Record variation and source limits.

attachments.requirements: Review both hip joints, L5/sacrum, sacroiliac relationships, muscle origins/insertions and pelvic-floor supports after fitting. Record tolerances and observed errors.

sections.requirements: Record coronal, sagittal and axial inspections of abdominal layers, pelvic organs/urethra/floor and breast tissue relationships; document intersections and gaps.

tissuePresentation.requirements: Review breast adipose/gland/duct/support and pectoral muscle distinctions, skin visibility, source labels and current teaching text.

poses.requirements: Review the SWR-518 acceptance poses: standing, overhead reach, hip flexion/squat, bridge, spinal rotation and side bend. Record joint axes, attachment continuity, muscle paths, clipping and supported movement claims.

teachingScope.requirements: An anatomist and a yoga/Pilates movement educator independently review this exact revision and agree on supported claims, limitations and any excluded critical findings.
